categories.name: أَصْنَافُ الْمُحْتَاجِينَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Categories of the Needy in the Quran

items.verseEn: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.
And He found you lost and guided [you],
And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.

categories.name: أَسْمَاءُ الشَّيْطَانِ وَصِفَاتُهُ
categories.nameEn: Names and Epithets of Satan in the Quran

items.verse: وَقَالَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ لَمَّا قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَعَدَكُمْ وَعْدَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَوَعَدتُّكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُكُمْ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ لِىَ عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍ إِلَّآ أَن دَعَوْتُكُمْ فَٱسْتَجَبْتُمْ لِى ۖ فَلَا تَلُومُونِى وَلُومُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُم ۖ مَّآ أَنَا۠ بِمُصْرِخِكُمْ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُصْرِخِىَّ ۖ إِنِّى كَفَرْتُ بِمَآ أَشْرَكْتُمُونِ مِن قَبْلُ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
items.verseEn: And Satan will say when the matter has been concluded, "Indeed, Allāh had promised you the promise of truth. And I promised you, but I betrayed you. But I had no authority over you except that I invited you, and you responded to me. So do not blame me; but blame yourselves. I cannot be called to your aid, nor can you be called to my aid. Indeed, I deny your association of me [with Allāh] before. Indeed, for the wrongdoers is a painful punishment."

items.verse: وَلَقَدْ صَدَّقَ عَلَيْهِمْ إِبْلِيسُ ظَنَّهُۥ فَٱتَّبَعُوهُ إِلَّا فَرِيقًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
items.verseEn: And Iblees had already confirmed through them his assumption, so they followed him, except for a party of believers.

items.verse: فَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ
items.verseEn: So when you recite the Qur’ān, [first] seek refuge in Allāh from Satan, the expelled [from His mercy].

items.verse: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
items.verseEn: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.

categories.name: مُفْرَدَاتٌ مِنْ قِصَّةِ أَصْحَابِ الْجَنَّةِ فِي سُورَةِ الْقَلَمِ
categories.nameEn: Vocabulary from the Story of the Owners of the Garden in Surah Al-Qalam

items.verseEn: And they called one another at morning,

items.verse: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰرِمِينَ
items.verseEn: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."
And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.

items.verse: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
items.verseEn: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allāh]?'"

categories.name: مُفْرَدَاتٌ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْأُمَمِ السَّابِقَةِ فِي سُورَةِ الْفَجْرِ
categories.nameEn: Vocabulary of Punishment of Ancient Nations in Surah Al-Fajr

items.verseEn: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes?
[All of] whom oppressed within the lands
Indeed, your Lord is in observation.

harf.arabicVerse: وَلَا تَأْكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا لَمْ يُذْكَرِ ٱسْمُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِسْقٌۭ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ لَيُوحُونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَوْلِيَآئِهِمْ لِيُجَـٰدِلُوكُمْ ۖ وَإِنْ أَطَعْتُمُوهُمْ إِنَّكُمْ لَمُشْرِكُونَ
harf.verse: 6:121 - And do not eat of that upon which the name of Allāh has not been mentioned, for indeed, it is grave disobedience. And indeed do the devils inspire their allies [among men] to dispute with you. And if you were to obey them, indeed, you would be associators [of others with Him].

deduction.title: The Silent Voice of the Valley
deduction.intro: Step back in time to a mighty people who once received a living marvel as a test. Arrogance and stubbornness sealed their fate. Can you trace the story and discover what unfolded in this dramatic turning point?
clues: I was sent as a divine trial to a mighty people known for their strength and defiance.
I was a unique marvel—the likes of me had never appeared among them.
I shared drinking water from a well with my people on alternate days.
They were warned that any harm against me would bring swift punishment.
The most daring of them ignored the warning and hamstrung me.
After my death, a single thunderous cry from above destroyed my entire people.

location.label: Key Element
options: A throne of gold and silver

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Burned by a shower of stones

deduction.verse: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her]. (54:29)

scramble.hint: A verse describing the best form of speech and conduct: calling to Allah, doing good deeds, and affirming one's submission to Him.
scramble.arabic: وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ قَوْلًۭا مِّمَّن دَعَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًۭا وَقَالَ إِنَّنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
scramble.verseEn: And who is better in speech than one who invites to Allāh and does righteousness and says, "Indeed, I am of the Muslims."
